source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When the enemy [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) finishes, choose one enemy unit the Ravenwing Dark Talon can see no farther than 24″ away, excluding **AIRCRAFT**. Until the enemy’s next [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) ends, roll one D6 whenever that unit is picked to move. Skip the roll if it Remains Stationary. On 1–4 it takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) and moves 2″ less. On 5–6 it takes 2D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) and moves 3″ less.
